text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing,
Vivlos invited me to go to a cafe.
Since it was "for a social media post," I assumed the teacher would be here today too, but—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: No, only for you, Trainy ♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: That's just the kind of day it is today♡ Come on, let's hurry and go♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
This place is super cute, so I come here a lot♪
I totally recommend it to you too, Trainie♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, look, look, Trainy!
It's a limited-time challenge menu!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Test Your Bond as a Pair!
Super Deluxe Celebrity Tower Parfait" ♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I'm de~finitely taking on a challenge like this♪

It seems she plans to post photos of her time at her favorite shop today.
In that case—

True to its name, the "Gorgeous Deluxe Celebrity Parfait"
we ordered turned out to be a formidable opponent—!
(Beeeeeeeeeep—)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... t-time's up already...!?
B-But, wait~~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Leaving food behind is rude!
Even if I didn't clear the challenge, I'm eating every last bit!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That parfait was super rough on me~!
My stomach's seriously gonna burst~.
choice_data_list: I think I'll pass on parfaits for a while...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Trainy-poo♡
(Splash—)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Aha♡ Trai-chi, you look like you're gonna cry!
And I can't stop grinning♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hey, it's okay if I post this photo, right?♡
choice_data_list: I-I was making a weird face, wasn't I...?
I-I was making a weird face, wasn't I...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
No, it was a wonderful photo♡
Proof of all the hard work we put in together, Trainy♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Today, this was what I wanted to take a picture of!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...You could tell when we went to see that play, couldn't you?
Everyone wants to know more about me."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: So today, the "usual me" will—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to show the real me,
without pretending to be someone I'm not.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Train, run a race, and then train again—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Going out together sometimes, laughing with each other—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Me, being with you like that, Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♡ Trainy looks so good in this photo!
You worked so, so hard for me, after all.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Maybe that's why? Looking at it makes my heart throb—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Mmmh.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Maybe I shouldn't post this after all...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh~... That certainly is
our "usual," but still~.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: After all, my "usual everyday life" is something you made for me, Trainy.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Working super, super hard
just for my sake!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, so I'll pass.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
We can talk about other things on Umastagram, too.
Our "everyday life" is—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: As long as the two of us know, that's all that matters, right? ♡
choice_data_list: Want to look for something else we can post instead?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
This face of yours looks like it'd go viral though, Trainy~âª
...Should I really post it?

Begging to be spared from that fate,
I pleaded with Vivlos.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "...Mm-hmm♡ Forever and ever, okay?♡"

Together with a smiling Vivlos,
I walked slowly along the twilight path.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Really!? Then, then!
Next up, let's take on the Jumbo Okonomiyaki Challenge—
I was thrown into a panic by Vivlos's joke.
